title: planner output
description: Canonical machine-readable output contract for the planner role. See agents/planner.md Step 4 (Validate your own DAG) and Step 0 (Knowledge Bank) for the prose contract this mirrors. The planner previously had no schema at all -- its dispatch ended 'Confirm with any text when done' -- so this is the contract that makes its output routable rather than free prose.

featureIds.description: Feature-level bead ids created or updated this round.

taskIds.description: Task-level bead ids created or updated this round.

kb_captures.description: IGNORED FOR THIS ROLE -- the planner has no apply path, so anything sent here is silently dropped rather than captured. Declared only for forward compatibility and shape-parity with the roles that do capture; always omit it or send []. Do not spend planning effort producing entries for it.

summary.description: The lesson in at most 2 sentences, present tense, standing alone as current truth.

trigger.description: What kind of event produced this lesson. Never "describes the change".

content.description: Optional. Written only when it adds what the summary cannot hold (labelled sections: Context, Symptom, Cause, Rule/Fix, Tried (failed), Evidence). Content that repeats the summary is refused.

source_files.description: Files that make this claim checkable. At least one is REQUIRED -- SqliteProvider.capture() rejects an entry with no basis, because the freshness sweep can never stale it.

recall_cues.description: Phrases a future reader would search for to find this lesson.

error_signatures.description: Exact error strings that this lesson explains.
